title: BTW Women In Tech Mixer 2026
description: Attend a women-first networking mixer in Bengaluru with founders, engineers, designers, and product leaders during Bengaluru Tech Week. Open to women builders across Bengaluru.
descriptionDetailed: This curated women-first evening brings together Bengaluru builders - founders, engineers, designers, product leaders, researchers, students, operators, and community leaders - for structured introductions, small-group circles, and real conversations. It is designed as a room for women that stays useful, safe, and high-signal rather than content-heavy. Spots are limited and curated, with approvals sent closer to the event date.

audience.eligibilityDetail: The mixer is curated for women founders, engineers, designers, product leaders, researchers, students, operators, and community leaders. Spots are limited and approval-based, with confirmations sent closer to the event date.
